set.st: F. Marion Ogle, an unmarried Warren County recluse, lived in a small shanty and dugout on his farm. His mules bolted near the cemetery south of Indianola on 8 July 1907 and he died on 17 July without regaining consciousness. A few days before the accident he had brought $10,000 he had hidden about the farm to an Indianola bank. His estate was put at $50,000-80,000 (land, Colorado farms, bank stock), and people believed more gold was still hidden on the farm. Pin is approximate, not the spot itself.
set.t: Two separate accounts; becomes B once the Ogle forty (shanty and dugout) is found on a 1900s Warren County plat near Medora. Access: private: permission.
